title: Mobility Equipment Self-Pay Sale Terms
content:
# Self-Pay Sale Terms — Mobility Equipment

**Term 1 — Sale.** Any Mobility Equipment class may be sold outright to a self-pay patient at the class's cash price plus the class's delivery fee, paid in full at order.

**Term 2 — Refund window, the base return rule.** "A self-pay chair is refunded only when it comes back unused and complete no later than the class's return window after delivery, counting calendar days from the day after the delivery date with the boundary day included; a class with a window of 0 or that is custom-configured is never refunded." This term is no longer in force for a cash-sale chair given back under the refund rule for a cash-sale chair given back, nor for a cash-sale chair the patient keeps under the price-adjustment rule for a cash-sale chair the patient keeps; it is superseded for those chairs by the current basis. A self-pay chair that is neither given back under the one rule nor kept under the other remains under this base return rule.

**Term 3 — Refund amount, the base refund rule.** "The refund is the price less the class's restocking fee percent, rounded to the cent half up; the delivery fee is never refunded." This term is no longer in force for the refund of a cash-sale chair given back nor for the price adjustment on a cash-sale chair the patient keeps; it is superseded for those by the current basis. A refund of a self-pay sale that is neither of those remains under this base refund rule.

**Term 4 — One refund per sale.** A sale is refunded at most once. Whether a sale has already been refunded is read from the system's billing records: a refund line already recorded against that sale line means it is not refunded again.

## Status of the terms

| Term | Status |
|---|---|
| 1 — sale at the cash price plus the delivery fee, paid in full at order | in force |
| 2 — refund window (base return rule) | no longer in force for a cash-sale chair given back under the refund rule or kept under the price-adjustment rule; in force for any other self-pay chair |
| 3 — refund amount (base refund rule) | no longer in force for the refund of a cash-sale chair given back or the price adjustment on a kept cash-sale chair; in force for any other refund of a self-pay sale |
| 4 — a sale refunded at most once | in force |

The class figures these terms name — the cash price, the delivery fee, the return window and the restocking fee — remain the class's listed values.

## Hypothetical sale

A self-pay patient ordering a Standard Manual Wheelchair (K0001) pays the cash price of 329.00 plus the delivery fee of 25.00, in full at order.

superseded_clauses: A self-pay chair is refunded only when it comes back unused and complete no later than `self_pay_return_window_days` after delivery, counting calendar days from the day after delivery_date with the boundary day included; a class with a window of 0 or that is `custom_configured` is never refunded.
The refund is the price less `self_pay_restocking_fee_pct` percent, rounded to the cent half up; the delivery fee is never refunded.
